phases.title: Engineering foundation
phases.doneWhen: Clean Windows build, tests, documented boundaries and working CI.

phases.title: Persistence
phases.doneWhen: Migrations, constraints, repositories and FTS5 are covered by integration tests.

phases.title: Crawler
phases.doneWhen: Recursive scans persist file/directory metadata, hash safely, respect exclusions and recover from errors.

phases.title: Windows service
phases.doneWhen: Automatic startup, least privilege, recovery and independent indexing work.

phases.title: Incremental indexing
phases.doneWhen: Creates, changes, renames and deletions converge correctly, including after downtime.

phases.title: IPC
phases.doneWhen: Authorized desktop/MCP clients communicate concurrently without direct database access.

phases.title: Desktop
phases.doneWhen: Users manage roots and monitor the service without affecting background indexing.

phases.title: Extraction and search
phases.doneWhen: Supported text/source/PDF/Office files are extracted locally and FTS returns useful excerpts.

phases.title: MCP
phases.doneWhen: Multiple independent agents query one index with the UI closed, with scoped tools/resources/prompts.

phases.title: Release hardening
phases.doneWhen: Clean installation, upgrade, recovery, backup and security acceptance pass.

phases.title: Advanced intelligence
phases.doneWhen: Local semantic search and agents work with model versions and source references.

issues.title: Create solution and projects
issues.scope: Create the nine specified source projects and traditional .sln with explicit inward dependencies; no runtime indexing.
acceptance: All projects compile on stable .NET 10.
Core/Contracts have no adapter dependencies; Desktop/McpServer cannot reference Storage directly or transitively.

issues.title: Configure central package management and build properties
issues.scope: Add Directory.Packages.props, SDK selection, nullable/analyzer settings, formatting and lockfiles.
acceptance: Package versions are central and locked restore succeeds.
Warnings are errors; .NET 11 previews are not selected; build is deterministic.

issues.title: Create test projects
issues.scope: Create UnitTests, IntegrationTests and AcceptanceTests using synthetic data; cover configuration, boundaries, SQL and MCP design contracts.
acceptance: All three suites run with dotnet test.
Tests never index personal folders, install services, change machine ACLs or need a cloud service.

issues.title: Write architecture and ADR documentation
issues.scope: Capture the supplied baseline, 15 ADRs, database/MCP contracts, security model, phases and working-index acceptance criteria.
acceptance: Documents agree with the nine components, initial schema, nine tools/resources/prompts and deferred semantics.
Phase 0 is clearly distinguished from an implemented working index.

issues.title: Add Copilot CLI instructions
issues.scope: Create AGENTS.md, Copilot guidance, issue/PR templates and the incremental development guide.
acceptance: The workflow requires a small plan, issue-scoped changes, tests and review.
Instructions prohibit personal-data fixtures, automatic indexing/service installation, and unapproved privacy scope expansion.

issues.title: Configure CI
issues.scope: Run locked restore, build, tests, formatting and safe configuration smoke check on Windows; pin Actions.
acceptance: The actual GitHub Actions workflow passes on main.
Workflow permissions are read-only and no personal data or credentials are in artifacts.

issues.title: SQLite connection factory
issues.scope: Implement Storage connection ownership with an explicitly supplied safe data directory; no crawler or UI.
acceptance: Every connection enables foreign keys and bounded busy timeout; WAL/durability settings are verified.
One writer/bounded readers, cancellation, access failure and unsafe storage paths have focused tests.

issues.title: Migration infrastructure
issues.scope: Implement immutable ordered SQL migrations, checksums, ledger transactions and pre-upgrade SQLite backups.
acceptance: Fresh/repeat/upgrade/rollback/crash-reopen cases pass on actual temporary databases.
Checksum mismatch, concurrent migration and unknown newer schema fail explicitly without deleting the database.

issues.title: Root persistence
issues.scope: Persist index_roots with stable IDs, UTC ISO 8601 times, normalized keys, consent/state and policy revisions.
acceptance: Insert/update/disable/remove are transactional and idempotent with uniqueness tests.
No implicit root is added; Unicode key handling and malformed timestamp/input cases are covered.

issues.title: File metadata persistence
issues.scope: Persist file_entries for files/directories with relative/parent paths, revisions, states and indexed lookup queries.
acceptance: Root/path uniqueness, stable IDs, rename/upsert, tombstones and directory queries are covered.
Transactions invalidate stale hash/content and never cross root ownership.

issues.title: Scan and job persistence
issues.scope: Persist scan generations/progress and deduplicated, prioritized, leased index_jobs.
acceptance: Claims, expiry recovery, finite retries and cancellation are atomic and tested.
Cross-root file jobs and invalid lease transitions fail; incomplete scans cannot trigger mass deletion.

issues.title: FTS5 schema and tests
issues.scope: Add file_contents and external-content FTS5 migrations with revision/access invalidation triggers.
acceptance: Real MATCH results stay correct after insert/update/delete/revision/root removal.
Use unicode61 diacritic removal; migrations include no chunks, embeddings or vectors.

issues.title: Root registration and validation
issues.scope: Enroll explicitly selected roots using actual Windows directory handles, identity/access checks and policy revisions.
acceptance: Reject drive roots, traversal/device/network paths, unsupported volumes, reparse escapes and denied access.
Configuration syntax alone cannot enroll a root; all filesystem tests use disposable synthetic trees.

issues.title: Recursive enumeration
issues.scope: Stream supported file/directory enumeration with bounded depth, memory, queues and cancellation.
acceptance: Empty selection does nothing; only the enrolled tree is visited.
Depth/permission/offline/cancellation failures mark scans incomplete, never successful or deleted.

issues.title: Metadata collection
issues.scope: Collect file/directory names, sizes, UTC filesystem times, identity and root-relative paths.
acceptance: Repeated scans do not duplicate entries; Unicode, long paths and disappearing files are tested.
Directories and hard-link paths are represented correctly without expanding consent.

issues.title: SHA-256 hashing
issues.scope: Hash authorized files incrementally with streaming SHA-256, cancellation and revision guards.
acceptance: Known synthetic vectors match; large files do not require whole-file buffering.
Files changed/replaced during hashing are discarded/retried safely; stale hashes are not reported as current.

issues.title: Exclusions and link handling
issues.scope: Persist/apply normalized relative exclusions and fail-closed symlink/junction/reparse handling.
acceptance: Exact/recursive exclusions and separator-prefix siblings are covered.
Junction swaps, link cycles, cloud placeholders and unsupported case-sensitive directories cannot escape or hydrate.

issues.title: Scan progress persistence
issues.scope: Persist progress/counts and reconcile interrupted scans without false completion.
acceptance: Counts/status survive restart and redacted failures are visible.
Only a successful complete generation can tombstone unseen entries; partial subtree failures retain safe state.

issues.title: Worker Service host
issues.scope: Replace the configuration-only host with Generic Host worker composition and explicit foreground developer mode.
acceptance: Indexing works without UI/agents and uses one service-owned database.
Shutdown cancellation, bounded concurrency and crash/expired-lease recovery are tested; no auto-install.

issues.title: Windows Service installation and startup
issues.scope: Add explicit secure SCM install/start/stop/uninstall procedures for supported owner accounts.
acceptance: An isolated Windows VM verifies automatic startup and recovery under the intended account.
No LocalSystem fallback or passwords in config/args/logs; uninstall preserves data unless purge is explicit.

issues.title: Health and lifecycle reporting
issues.scope: Expose service readiness, counts, scan/job state, pause and failure information through application queries.
acceptance: Startup/migration/indexing/degraded/shutdown states are distinguishable.
Counters are bounded/correct and errors are explicit rather than success-shaped defaults.

issues.title: Logging and diagnostics
issues.scope: Add bounded local structured diagnostics with stable codes, correlation and retention.
acceptance: Paths, document text, raw queries, credentials and protocol payloads are absent from logs.
Rotation, repeated failure and disk-write failures are visible without unbounded log growth.

issues.title: Service account and folder permission validation
issues.scope: Validate supported account/service-logon behavior and explicit per-owner storage/root permissions.
acceptance: Installation checks the actual service identity, data ACLs and selected-root access.
Unsupported/Hello-only configurations fail safely; no elevation to bypass denied file access.

issues.title: FileSystemWatcher
issues.scope: Observe only enabled selected roots with bounded watcher lifetime and overflow handling.
acceptance: Root disable/removal/disconnect disposes or suspends watchers correctly.
Overflow schedules reconciliation; watchers never become the authoritative inventory.

issues.title: Event normalization and debouncing
issues.scope: Coalesce rapid saves, duplicate/out-of-order events and rename pairs into bounded normalized work.
acceptance: Synthetic event bursts produce deterministic work without unbounded memory.
Traversal/out-of-scope events are rejected and debounce cancellation is tested.

issues.title: Background job processor
issues.scope: Process durable leased jobs using backpressure and current file/root-policy checks.
acceptance: Concurrent claims, restarts and duplicate delivery do not corrupt or duplicate results.
Stale/revoked work cannot commit and cancellation releases or expires leases safely.

issues.title: Retry handling
issues.scope: Implement finite classified retries and visible terminal failure states.
acceptance: Transient sharing/contention failures use bounded backoff; permanent denial is not a hot loop.
Retry schedules survive restart and honor cancellation/root disable.

issues.title: Periodic reconciliation
issues.scope: Reconcile on startup, interval, reconnect and watcher overflow using complete scan generations.
acceptance: Missed events and service downtime converge to a fresh synthetic scan.
Offline/inaccessible/partial trees never cause false mass deletion.

issues.title: Deletion and stale-record handling
issues.scope: Implement immediate query hiding, content invalidation, tombstones and bounded retention cleanup.
acceptance: Delete/rename/root removal remove FTS data and cannot return stale content.
Restart/partial-scan cases preserve correctness and cleanup never deletes source files.

issues.title: Versioned contracts
issues.scope: Define transport-only DTOs, query/control operations, version envelopes and stable errors in Contracts.
acceptance: Serialization round trips and major-version compatibility are tested.
Contracts has no database/filesystem/UI dependency and matches the documented tool-facing use cases.

issues.title: Named Pipe server
issues.scope: Host bounded framed pipe endpoints in the service with separate query/control dispatch.
acceptance: Lengths are checked before allocation; malformed/oversized frames and broken pipes fail explicitly.
Queries keep SQLite ownership in the service and do not expose unauthenticated access.

issues.title: Named Pipe client
issues.scope: Implement a cancellable versioned IPC client in Infrastructure for desktop and MCP consumers.
acceptance: Connect/disconnect/reconnect/deadline behavior is bounded and tested.
Client code cannot open Storage and never blocks the UI with synchronous waits.

issues.title: Identity and ACL enforcement
issues.scope: Enforce owner/SYSTEM pipe ACLs, peer/server identity, remote rejection and capability separation.
acceptance: Isolated Windows identities prove cross-user/remote/spoofed-server denial.
Query capabilities cannot execute control operations; grant revocation is checked before responses.

issues.title: Protocol negotiation and timeouts
issues.scope: Complete major/minor negotiation, request correlation, concurrent connections, cancellation and error mapping.
acceptance: Version mismatch, timeout, half-closed connection and malformed JSON are covered.
Independent clients cannot receive each other's responses and resource limits are enforced.

issues.title: WinUI 3 and MVVM foundation
issues.scope: Turn Desktop into a real WinUI 3 app with pinned Windows App SDK and CommunityToolkit.Mvvm.
acceptance: Windows 11 x64 launch/package smoke checks pass.
View models use IPC; keyboard, screen-reader, high contrast and DPI basics are validated.

issues.title: Dashboard
issues.scope: Display root/file/directory counts, indexing state and service health without blocking the UI.
acceptance: Counts and progress update from IPC and missing/degraded service states are explicit.
UI closure does not stop service indexing; view-model failure/cancellation tests pass.

issues.title: Root management
issues.scope: Add explicit select/validate/enable/disable/remove/reindex workflows with scope and purge explanations.
acceptance: No root is preselected; consent shows exact scope and unsupported roots fail visibly.
Removal/disable cancels work and gates queries; purging explains physical-erasure limits.

issues.title: Directory explorer
issues.scope: Display paged indexed children/trees and metadata through IPC, not direct enumeration.
acceptance: Large/empty/deleted/offline directories have bounded responsive states.
Relative path traversal and stale paging are handled explicitly.

issues.title: Activity and error views
issues.scope: Show redacted scan/job activity, failures and retry state with actionable controls.
acceptance: Permission, extraction, offline and migration failures are distinguishable.
Views are paged and never display secret/contents from raw diagnostic payloads.

issues.title: Tray integration
issues.scope: Add accessible tray open/close/status behavior without owning service lifetime.
acceptance: UI/tray exit leaves service indexing; reopen restores connection/state.
Duplicate instances, shutdown and notification-area lifecycle are tested.

issues.title: Settings and exclusions
issues.scope: Edit bounded local settings and normalized exclusions through owner control IPC.
acceptance: Changes persist and safely trigger required reconciliation/policy revision.
Invalid settings/exclusions fail visibly; no hidden scope expansion or cloud default.

issues.title: Extractor interface
issues.scope: Define local extractor inputs/results, revision/provenance, supported types and explicit failure/budget contracts.
acceptance: Interfaces support cancellation, size/time limits and isolated read-only handle processing.
No cloud, Office automation or arbitrary path access is embedded in the contract.

issues.title: Text, Markdown, JSON, XML and CSV extraction
issues.scope: Implement strict local text decoding and bounded isolated extraction for the specified formats.
acceptance: Encoding/BOM/Unicode, oversized content, invalid input and concurrent file changes are covered.
Restricted-token/handle/network denial and Job Object budgets are tested; XML external entities are disabled.

issues.title: Source-code extraction
issues.scope: Add explicit source-extension handling and plain-text extraction with provenance.
acceptance: Supported source files index as data without compilation/execution.
Binary/minified/oversized/invalid encoding cases are bounded and explicit.

issues.title: PDF extraction
issues.scope: Add a reviewed pinned local PDF parser inside the existing isolation boundary.
acceptance: Synthetic valid/malformed/encrypted/large PDFs and parser crash/timeouts are covered.
No network links, active content, cloud conversion or unapproved OCR; licensing/deployment risks are recorded.

issues.title: Office extraction
issues.scope: Extract supported Office formats locally using reviewed parsers, without Office automation.
acceptance: Synthetic document/spreadsheet/presentation, corrupt package, zip-bomb and encrypted-file cases are bounded.
Macros/external relationships never execute or fetch network content; unsupported legacy formats are explicit.

issues.title: FTS5 search service
issues.scope: Implement parameterized, grant-scoped literal-term FTS queries with ranking, excerpts, paging and freshness.
acceptance: Metadata-only access cannot infer content through matches/excerpts; stale/revoked content is excluded.
FTS escaping, byte/result limits, snapshot mismatch and a documented synthetic performance baseline are tested.

issues.title: Search UI
issues.scope: Add metadata/full-text search, filters, excerpts and source references through IPC.
acceptance: Search stays responsive with cancellation and explicit empty/partial/failure states.
Excerpts are rendered as plain untrusted text; no active links/macros or direct SQLite.

issues.title: MCP server executable
issues.scope: Replace the fail-fast scaffold with an official-SDK executable and pinned protocol compatibility.
acceptance: SDK version/negotiation and supported protocol versions are recorded.
There is no HTTP listener, cloud dependency or direct Storage reference.

issues.title: stdio transport
issues.scope: Implement SDK stdio lifecycle, clean stdout, stderr diagnostics, cancellation and EOF shutdown.
acceptance: Real process tests cover initialize, malformed messages, cancellation and EOF.
Only protocol JSON reaches stdout; diagnostics contain no personal data.

issues.title: IPC client integration
issues.scope: Map MCP requests to authenticated service queries with deadlines and explicit errors.
acceptance: Service unavailable/version mismatch/broken pipe/timeout map correctly.
Adapter never opens SQLite or arbitrary files and does not auto-start elevated services.

issues.title: Agent registration and sessions
issues.scope: Persist clients/sessions, owner-approved per-root/content grants, DPAPI capabilities and visible declared locality.
acceptance: New clients have no grants; registration/revocation/session cleanup and locality unknown/cloud/local are tested.
Consent management is owner-controlled; profile IDs or client locality claims alone never authorize access.

issues.title: Read-only tools, resources and prompts
issues.scope: Implement all nine tools, three resources and three prompts exactly as versioned contracts.
acceptance: Schema/example/protocol tests cover each operation, bounded outputs, relative-path and file-ID resolution.
No mutating tool, arbitrary URI/path, sampling or scope expansion; prompt expansion reads no files.

issues.title: Authorization and audit events
issues.scope: Complete service-side grant/live-access enforcement and scoped redacted audit/resource events.
acceptance: Cross-root/client, revoked/disabled, stale/read-size and metadata-only content inference cases are denied.
Audit/resource data omit paths, queries, contents and secrets; retention and response limits are enforced.

issues.title: Multiple-client integration tests
issues.scope: Exercise at least two independent MCP client implementations against separate adapters sharing one service.
acceptance: Concurrent tools/resources/prompts, cancellation, EOF, grant isolation and UI-closed operation pass.
Record versions/configurations and show that strict local AI also requires local clients/models.

issues.title: Installer and upgrade strategy
issues.scope: Package a versioned Windows release with explicit install/upgrade/rollback/uninstall behavior.
acceptance: Clean isolated Windows install and upgrade preserve roots/grants/data or fail recoverably.
No insecure account fallback, silent model download or automatic destructive uninstall.

issues.title: Service and filesystem permissions
issues.scope: Validate deployment-time service, binary, data-directory, pipe and root permissions.
acceptance: Clean install/upgrade/restart retain owner-only boundaries under separate Windows identities.
Reparse/ACL swaps and writable binary/data paths fail closed; no bypass privileges are granted.

issues.title: Backup and restore
issues.scope: Provide owner-controlled SQLite backup/restore and documented retention/encryption limits.
acceptance: WAL-active backup, restore, corruption, wrong/newer version and interrupted restore cases pass.
Backups inherit restrictive permissions; no silent reset or physical secure-erase claims.

issues.title: Diagnostics
issues.scope: Finalize bounded redacted operational diagnostics and owner-controlled support information.
acceptance: Useful correlation/error/health evidence is available without document text or secrets.
Disk pressure, repeated failures and support export are bounded and explicitly approved.

issues.title: Security and acceptance tests
issues.scope: Exercise working-index and release acceptance in clean Windows VMs using adversarial synthetic fixtures.
acceptance: Install/UI/root/index/close-UI/change/restart/no-cloud working-index criteria pass.
Authorization, TOCTOU, parser isolation, upgrade/recovery, resource budgets and unresolved risks are documented.

issues.title: Chunking
issues.scope: Add a separate migration and revision-bound chunks with offsets/provenance, after the initial release.
acceptance: Chunk boundaries preserve Unicode and source references with bounded overlap.
Source change/revocation purges stale chunks; initial migrations are not rewritten.

issues.title: Local embeddings
issues.scope: Import owner-approved local model/tokenizer artifacts and generate bounded offline embeddings.
acceptance: Checksum/license/version/dimension/normalization metadata is verified and persisted.
No automatic download/cloud inference; cancellation, memory limits and model-change invalidation are tested.

issues.title: Local vector search
issues.scope: Implement a bounded exact reference, then select an ANN/native index only with measured justification.
acceptance: Golden synthetic retrieval cases and a benchmark-backed selection ADR exist.
Incompatible models/vectors are never mixed; root/content grants and revocation are enforced.

issues.title: Semantic search MCP tool
issues.scope: Version and expose optional local semantic retrieval with source IDs and provenance.
acceptance: Tool is disabled until a model is explicitly configured and approved.
Schemas, multi-client behavior, bounds and content authorization are tested; no silent cloud fallback.

issues.title: Summaries and related-file discovery
issues.scope: Add explicitly local, approved-model intelligence with evidence and related-file references.
acceptance: Summaries distinguish inference from evidence and cite current authorized sources.
Prompt injection, model budgets, cancellation and locality are addressed; no autonomous file mutation.

issues.title: Local agent integration
issues.scope: Validate end-to-end local agents/models with the completed intelligence surface.
acceptance: Recorded agent/model versions work with networking disabled and independently scoped sessions.
Data remains local under the tested configuration and locality claims/limitations are explicit.
